description: Total program (advertising) spend for a marketplace over a period, converted to the marketplace currency. A single-row aggregate across all clients of the agency. Filter by channel to isolate PLA (os_product_ads) vs Display (guaranteed_display_ads / auction_display_ads) spend.

channel.description: Ad program channel: os_product_ads (PLA), guaranteed_display_ads / auction_display_ads (Display). Use as a filter to scope spend to a program type.

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cvcpf.cost * scc.conversion_factor ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: Total program spend over the period, converted to the marketplace currency.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.client_vendor_channel_performance_facts` AS cvcpf INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.clients` AS clients ON clients.client_id = cvcpf.client_id AND clients.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON mc.agency_id = clients.agency_id AND clients.client_id != mc.marketplace_client_id INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.static_currency_conversion` AS scc ON scc.from_currency = cvcpf.currency AND scc.to_currency = mc.currency WHERE cvcpf.vendor = 'os_ads' AND cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__;
